A '''Toydarian minister''' was present on the [[Toydarian ministry council]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

==Biography==
When the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] was [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], the inhabitants began to suffer. This minister was present in the [[Toydarian palace/Legends|Toydarian palace]] alongside [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] and a few other ministers when [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] Representative [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] approached them, asking for aid for the suffering [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] on Ryloth. But [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] Senator [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] arrived in a bid to make sure that no relief supply ship is sent to Ryloth. Katuunko then proposed for a debate. After both factions finished their debate, the [[Unidentified Toydarian defense minister/Legends|defense minister]] suggested they help the Twi'leks as compassion was a way of the Toydarians. Katuunko officially denies the Republic their rights to a base on Toydaria, but afterwards he secretly meets Organa and Binks and tells them that the humanitarian factor has actually gained his favor.
